children: Just a day ahead of crucial 3Q 2026 Australian inflation data, a survey has shown that consumer inflationary expectations are at their highest since May. The survey by ANZ Bank and Roy Morgan puts inflation expectations above 6.0% on year, which confirms the worst fears of the Reserve Bank of Australia that inflation expectations are a growing problem. Coming as the RBA indicates it has lost patience with inflation running hot, the data suggests that interest rates will rise further if core inflation stays elevated in 3Q. A reading of 1.0% on quarter or more would likely lock in the RBA's fifth hike this year. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
